# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:**

Consider the Divine infl ux, which proceeded from the Lord 's spiritual operation in the beginning. It fl owed down into the celestial will that had descended into obsc urity and combat with evil. It is a communication of in most peace and the good of charity, ordered and directed toward what is conjoined with it by mutual love, in which all states of the spiritual life from first to last are insc ribed according to Divine providence , together with everything that Divine truth will accomplish and establish in the course of regeneration. That Divine influx , received by the celest ial will, ord ains all that is to unf old in the restoration of what was lost.

**¶3:**

The recip rocal acknowledgment that arose from the celest ial will asc ended to the interior and higher degrees, to the Lord 's spiritual operation. It is likewise an ordered communication , elevated from the depths of tem ptation toward the Divine, in which every state of spiritual combat is laid open — every temptation, every struggle that had been end ured against the h ells. All that had been suffered and all that remained to be underg one, all that evil had wr ought and whatever yet awa ited resolution — all of it was contained in that ascending acknowledg ment. And the Lord's spiritual operation perceived with perfect compreh ension every tem ptation, every pe ril, and every assault that the dominant ev ils and falsities of the natural mind had waged against the celestial good held capt ive among them .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The answer that was sent from the First Man came to the heights, to the Living Spirit. That is also a letter, which was sent from the First Man to the Living Spirit, in which all the tidings are written down; and every war and the struggles that he had waged. It did [set forth all these things] in the answer that the First Man [sent up, declaring] everything that had happened and everything [that would happen], all that had been done and whatever is made ready to be done by him. The Living Spirit knew all the wars and the dangers and the contests that the rulers had waged against the First Man.

Consider the summons, which was sent from the Living Spirit in the beginning. He sent it to the First Man. It is a peace letter and greeting that he wrote and sent to his brother, in which all the tidings are written down, together with everything it will bring about and establish by that summons. That summons, the First Man [... is ordained to happen.]
